dict.string: JustType uses Apple Events to inject converted text into the focused application.
JustType needs Accessibility permission to monitor your hold-to-type modifier key and capture keystrokes while in fuzzy input mode.

JustType captures a snapshot of your screen at the moment of conversion to give the language model context (which app you're in, the surrounding language) so it can pick the right interpretation. The screenshot is sent only to the LLM endpoint you configured and is not stored locally.
